title: Fire department input on housing density bills
summary: Maui's fire department gave safety input to County Council committees on housing proposals, including safe parking lots where people can sleep in vehicles overnight and accessory dwelling rules allowing up to three dwellings per property. In February 2025, a fire captain said officials cannot require extra fire protection when several code-built homes share one lot. In 2024, the fire chief called housing a crisis but warned of density, substandard roads and evacuation safety.
